name: operations.transfers

list.description: Read full native transfer orders within the verified inquiry scope.

parameters.name: from-date
parameters.description: Beijing GMT+08 business start day YYYY-MM-DD; both ordered bounds required.

parameters.name: to-date
parameters.description: Inclusive Beijing GMT+08 business end day YYYY-MM-DD.

get.description: Read one complete native detail root; separate histories and child endpoints are unqueried.

lookup.name: orderNo
lookup.description: Native transfer orderNo from the List; orderId/reportId are separate references.

result_identity.description: Native returned orderNo; validated against the requested lookup without changing its type.

purpose: Inspect native transfer orders through bounded inquiry-only requests.

fields.name: orderNo
fields.meaning: Native transfer order identity; orderId and reportId are separate references.

fields.name: debitAmount
fields.meaning: Native decimal text or null/blank, preserved without conversion.

fields.name: creditAmount
fields.meaning: Native decimal text or null/blank; distinct from debit amount.

fields.name: orderStatus
fields.meaning: Native order state, separate from receiptStatus and executeResult.

identity_description: Stable native orderNo identifies one document; latest validated gmtModified selects its complete observed version within this acquisition.
limitations: Fixed GUAPW3SG tenant. POST form /transferOrderQuery.json contains a serialized transferOrderQueryRequestVO with fixed empty debitEntity/creditEntity arrays and blank debit/credit date bounds.

Required Beijing ISO dates expand to inclusive full-day seconds. Convert each endpoint independently with America/Los_Angeles seasonal rules for the offset-free native transaction query clock. Returned GMT+08 fields remain raw.
Absolute rowStart offsets use pageSize=1000. Top-level count must equal result.count; records are result.data. Other native filters are unsupported.

Preserve full native rows, nested logs, unknown fields and nullable monetary strings. orderStatus, receiptStatus and executeResult remain separate raw states; no bank-success inference or detail enrichment.

The host SDK owns retries, completeness and publication. Declared latest_by selects full rows by validated native gmtModified (GMT+08); resolved versions/ties warn and can be complete. Native totals retain unique-object meaning; duplicates and traversal/count gaps remain objective. Widths are qualified values, not measured backend maxima.
Native baseResult.data transfer root; no account enrichment, HTML unescaping, status interpretation or additional log inquiry.
Get and supported List --live --with-detail preserve native types, nesting and unknown fields, perform no implicit history/child inquiries, and write no cache or Duckdog data.

examples.title: Combine the selected List window with native detail
